# ASCII

Redraws the image as text: each cell becomes the character whose ink matches its brightness, in the original colors or in two theme colors.

<EffectDemo effect="ascii" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { ascii } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/ascii';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(ascii({ preset: 'terminal' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.cellSize = 8`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                                         | Default      | Range     | Description                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------ | -------------------------------------------- | ------------ | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `cellSize`   | number                                       | `8`          | 4 – 32 px | Width of a character cell; cells are 4:3 tall.                                                                                                    |
| `charset`    | 'classic' \| 'binary' \| 'blocks' \| 'atlas' | `'classic'`  |           | Classic is the ramp " .:-=+*#%@", binary uses 1 and 0 (blank in the dark), blocks draws shaded blocks, atlas uses every tile of the font texture. |
| `colorMode`  | 'original' \| 'mono'                         | `'original'` |           | Draw characters in the colors underneath, or in the foreground color.                                                                             |
| `foreground` | hex color                                    | `'#e8f0ff'`  |           | Mono: character color.                                                                                                                            |
| `background` | hex color                                    | `'#05070c'`  |           | Color behind the characters.                                                                                                                      |
| `brightness` | number                                       | `1`          | 0.25 – 3  | Gain before picking a character.                                                                                                                  |
| `invert`     | boolean                                      | `false`      |           | Use dense characters for dark areas, for dark text on a light background.                                                                         |
| `font`       | 2D texture or 'font5x7'                      | `'font5x7'`  |           | A strip of 6×8-texel glyph tiles ordered from least to most ink; the built-in one holds " .:-=+*#%@01".                                           |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset     | Settings                                                                                                   |
| ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `terminal` | `colorMode: 'mono'`, `foreground: '#33ff66'`, `background: '#020a04'`                                      |
| `matrix`   | `charset: 'binary'`, `colorMode: 'mono'`, `foreground: '#5dff8a'`, `background: '#000000'`, `cellSize: 10` |
| `blocks`   | `charset: 'blocks'`, `cellSize: 6`                                                                         |
| `paper`    | `colorMode: 'mono'`, `foreground: '#1b1b1b'`, `background: '#f2eee3'`, `invert: true`                      |

Apply one with `ascii({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Retro & display · tracked as story X8.3 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** samples the pass input at other positions, so it starts a new merged pass; following pixel effects join that pass.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.6 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/ascii`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Related

- [Pixelate](./pixelate) — Big square, hexagonal or round pixels, each the color at its center.
- [Halftone](./halftone) — Print-style halftone screens: four rotated CMYK screens, a single ink, or additive RGB, drawn as dots, lines or squares sized by the tone under each cell.
- [Dither](./dither) — Reduces each channel to a few levels and hides the banding with a dither pattern: ordered Bayer matrices, void-and-cluster blue noise, or interleaved gradient noise.
